answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves meaningful weight. EigenTrust factorization assigns freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming attestations; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap isolated collusion. Consequently, consensus rejects them, favoring durable sable links across the garden rather than identities emerging from a tundra.
